grid.note: beat k at t0 + k*period (k may be negative); bar b starts at beat 4b; beat 0 is the first downbeat

sections.note: PROTECTION -> SIMULATION: the program boots - power line, object creation, initialization, sung over drums+bass with no pad.
Title drop 'world.execute(me);' (not sung - vocals silent); the full synth layer enters, instrumental.
Verse 1 - geometry lessons: points/DIMENSION, circle/CIRCUMFERENCE, sine/TANGENTS, infinity/LIMITATIONS.
Pre-chorus 1 - AC to DC, so dizzy, A.D to B.C, unite so deeply; bass more active.
Chorus 1 (+1.5 dB) - STIMULATIONS, SATISFACTION, EXECUTION, trapped in SIMULATION.
Verse 2 - eggplant/NUTRIENTS, tomato/ANTIOXIDANTS, tabby cat/ENJOYMENT, god/EXISTENCE; drum drop at bar 40.
Pre-chorus 2 - F to M, AM to PM, S to M, the trance; drums thin out (drops at bars 50 and 55).
4-bar extension inserted into chorus 2 - 'you have left' x6 -> ISOLATION; bass and vocals pull back.
Chorus 2 resumes but the program breaks - FRAGMENTS, DISHEARTENED, 'challenging your god', ILLEGAL ARGUMENTS.
Instrumental after the crash - no vocals, full band.
EXECUTION x12 (one every 2 beats, some syncopated by a 16th) + EIN DOS TROIS NE FEM LIU (one per beat) + EXECUTION.
Chorus 3 (+1.5 dB) - every keyword is now EXECUTION; 'if I can have you back', 'we are trapped ah'.
LO-O-OVE x4 - studied how to properly love, algebraic expression of love, 'though you are free, I am trapped'.
Outro - vocals and pad drop out, drums+bass groove; final EXECUTION at bar 111.
Final EXECUTION rings out and decays (below -60 dBFS at ~207.8 s, digital silence from ~209.0 s) to the end of the film.

notes.beats: Fixed grid 130.0030 BPM fitted by robust least squares (period x phase scan, then LSQ on inliers) to beat_this 'final0' beats; madmom RNN+DBN independently gives 130.0025 BPM. Phase corrected by the median offset of strong drum-stem onsets (-5.64 ms). Downbeat = beat index = 0 mod 4 (votes beat_this [113, 3, 0, 0], madmom [112, 0, 0, 0]). No tempo drift: per-15 s median residuals of drum onsets stay within +-10 ms over the whole song.
notes.beat_error_note: max errors (~220 ms) are tracker artefacts at 89.3-90.7 s where beat_this inserts two half-beats and drops one; the robust grid is unaffected. beat_this output is quantised to 20 ms, madmom to 10 ms.
notes.sections: Boundaries on bar lines from lyric lines + per-bar stem RMS. Musically bars 56-72 are one extended chorus; it is split by narrative: c2 (56-60), c2x (60-64, the inserted 'you have left' extension), bridge (64-72, the program breaks). Vocal pickups (up to 0.5 s) before their section's downbeat.
notes.lyrics: VTT has line times only. Word times: CTC forced alignment on the demucs vocals stem with torchaudio WAV2VEC2_ASR_LARGE_LV60K_960H (MMS_FA as fallback, best mean confidence per phrase group), 4 sub-frame window offsets averaged; then refined to the sung NOTE onset using torchcrepe f0 steps, voicing onset and voiced-band energy rise (s05_refine.py). word.start = first sung note onset (vowel / pitch), word.attack = audible leading consonant. All capitalised keywords were checked by hand against the audio (keywords_verified.json): 44 confirmed, 7 corrected; the verified times are used. Automatic-vs-verified distance on keywords is in keyword_auto_vs_verified. Word sources: {'note': 316, 'verified': 44, 'corrected': 7, 'ctc': 28, 'title': 3}. Non-keyword words are automatic (typical error +-40 ms).
notes.title_line: 'world.execute(me);' is not sung (vocals stem silent after 15.0 s); its tokens are placed on beats 32-34 (the inst1 drop) and marked sung:false.
notes.song_length: mp3 decodes to 212.323 s; music ends at 207.843 s (last sample > -60 dBFS), followed by digital silence. The film uses 12955 song frames = 215.9167 s, 3.593 s past the end of the mp3 (a silent tail for the end credits; the render pads the audio with silence).
